title: Logic Jailbreak: Efficiently Unlocking LLM Safety Restrictions Through Formal Logical Expression
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a jailbreaking method ('LogiBreak') that uses formal logical expressions to bypass safety filters. While the evaluation includes safety categories related to human values (e.g., harassment, fraud, and sexual content), the work is focused on the technical robustness and security of safety mechanisms rather than benchmarking moral reasoning, religious understanding, or ethical frameworks.
